config.label: Base58 (or JSON byte-array) Solana secret key that signs payments and holds the USDC
config.description: Base58 (or JSON byte-array) Solana secret key that signs payments and holds the USDC. Not needed for the read tools (find_services, inspect_endpoint, or x402_wallet with an explicit address). Treat like cash.

config.label: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint
config.description: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public cluster — bring your own (Helius / Quicknode / Triton) for production traffic.

config.label: Max USD a single pay_and_call may spend
config.description: Max USD a single pay_and_call may spend. Bounds a runaway or injected payment.

config.label: When on (default), pay_and_call refuses until re-issued with confirm:true
config.description: When on (default), pay_and_call refuses until re-issued with confirm:true. Set 0/false to disable the gate.

config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves /api/bazaar/search for find_services. Override only when self-hosting.
